faq_connect_a: Go to Settings → Integrations and enter your store URL along with the Consumer Key and Consumer Secret from WooCommerce → Settings → Advanced → REST API.
faq_sync_a: Check that the WooCommerce API key has Read permission. If you use Cloudflare, make sure our IPs aren't blocked. You can run the sync again from the Products page.

faq_needs_q: What do I need to launch a campaign?
faq_needs_a: A connected store (Edinio, WooCommerce or Shopify), a Google Ads account, your products in Google Merchant Center and purchases tracked in Google Ads. Hontrio checks all of this before launch and tells you what's missing.
faq_ads_cost_a: You do, directly to Google, with the card in your Google Ads account. Ad money never goes through Hontrio, and you choose the daily budget.
